title: Messy
text: Messy. This incense holder looks nice, but it is super messy. The ashes just fall all over the place. You can put multiple sticks in at a time. The top two flowers come off of the third flower, but they don’t connect. The top just sits onto the bottom. Again, they look nice but the mess and construction aren’t ideal.
